title: The \(V_n\) Invariants as Colored Links--Gould Invariants:A Root--Center Approach
summary: The knot invariants \(V_n\) arise from a rank-two Nichols algebra and a \(4n\)-dimensional right Yetter--Drinfeld module, whereas the colored Links--Gould invariants are defined from typical \(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}(2|1))\)-modules. We prove that these two constructions agree, up to the mirror and parameter inversion forced by the right-module convention. The proof is structural. We first realize the braid operator \(T_n\) as a gauge transform of a canonical super Yetter--Drinfeld braiding.
